Henry ood.
--- Page 3 --- Ka East Lynne DA KA MRS.
HENRY WOOD.
La Pynkylla Khasi DA U Bah Frank M.
Pugh, Jaiaw, Shillong.
Ka jingshon banyngkong 1964.
KITAB I(a) Ka dor 1 T.
La shon ba ka Shillong Printing Works, Shillong.

--- Page 5 --- KA 'TIENSHUWA Ha kaba pynkylla Khasi ia kane ka novel badonnam, u nongpynkylla um lah khlem da kynmaw tympang ia ki sngi ka jinglong khynnah samla jong u ha kaba u sdang ban pule ia kane ka jingiathuhkhana bapawnam.Lehse hiar na kikot kiba na kane ka jait ba u la pule kham buinwat bunkylla ban ia kane,bad ha man ka sien ba u pule ia ka um lahkhlem da pynhap umjer khlur,kham- tam ha kaba kut jong ka jingiathuhkhana, ba ka ktah pynsngew myllung mynsiem ia ki jingjia kumba la batai bniah hangne.
Kane ka la pynlong ban pyrkhat ba shisien ka sngi un thaw buit thaw lad da kumno ban pyn- loh lem ha la ki para ri ia ka jingbang bad jingsngewtyn- nat jong ka.

Katha nang iaid ki sngi ki pcr u la nang peit iaroh ia kaneka kynthei briew kaba la lah ban thoh kaba kum kane ka jingiathuhkhana, bad u da thrang mynsiem lem ba na la ki pitra-ri yn mih kiba kum kine ki nongthoh ban pynbang pynthiang ia ka jingsngap ki shkor, ban pyn shngiam ia ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad pyntuid um shini ha ka mynsiem ba sliang lem ban tip ja ka jingshem bad jingshah shitom ki para jyngthaw.

Kane ka nongthoh ka la thoh ym duna ia 40 tylli ki kot jingiathuhkhana hapdeng ka jingbin kam jong ka ha kaba peit la ki khun ki kti jong ka bad ia la u lok.Ia kane kawei hi ka kot la pynkylla sha kiba bun ki ktien jong ka pyrthei.La kha ia ka ha ka snem 1814 u January 19 tarik bad ka la iap haba ka la dap hynniewphew lai snem, ha ka snem 1887 February 10 tarik, la ka la long ka briew ka bam koit bam khiah bha ka met.
Jaiaw, Shillong.
--- Page 7 --- KIKYNTHUP Lyn Peij I.
Ka ady oubel 2.
Biengphna ba la khein ...
Ka Barbara Hfare 31 4.
a ingiakren paramarwei or ohai bnai 55 5: Xa phis u r &arlyle ...
U Pichard Hare samla ...
Ka Miso arlyle ha Ling I08 8.
a ingpyni ensad u r Kane ...
i ymbit ha ku yng.
khangit 138 --- Page 9 --- Ki briew kiba iadon bynta ha ka East Lynne.
William Vane--u Lord Mount Severn.
Lucy Vane--ka tnga jong u.
Isabel Vane-ka khin marwei, hadien pat ka tnga nyng- kong u Archibald Carlyle.
Warburton & Ware--ki riewsaid u Lord Mount Severn.
Beauchamp--u ejen u Lord Mount Severn.
Mrs Mason--ka shakri ing u Lord Mount Severn.
Mr Wells-u nonghiah-kali u Lord Mount Severn.
Dennis---u shakri shongkulai u Lord Mount Severn.
Pound-u nongrah khuri ka Isabel.
Archibald Carlyle--u khun baar u Carlyle ba la iap.
Davidson--u kynum u Carlyle ba la iap.
Miss Cornelia Carlyle--ka hynmen kha u Archibald.
Mr Dill--u klark rangbah u Carlyle.
Peter--u shakri-ing u Carlyle.
John--u nongniah-kali ka ing u Carlyle Blair--u mali u Carlyle.
Marvel bad Susan--ki shakri ka Isabel.
Mrs Levison--ka tymmen palat 80 snem.
Mr Francis Levison-u ksiew ka Mrs Levison.
Emma Vane--ka Lady Mount Severn hadien pat.
Earl Vane--u Lord Mount Severn hadien pat.
William Vane--u khun rit ki Mount Severn.
Richard Hare--u Justice Hare ka West Lynne Mrs Hare--ka tnga u Justice Hare, Anne Hare-ka khin nyngkong jong ki.
Richard Hare (samla)--u khin marwei.
Barbara Hare-ka khatduh ki Hare, ka tnga u Carlyle hadien.
Miss Wilson--ka shakri-ing ki Hare, hadien pat jong ka Isabel.
Jaspar--u shakri-ing ki Hare.
Benjamin-u nonghiah-kali ki Hare..
John Hallijohnuba shah pyniap.
Joyce Hallijohn--ka khun nyngkong jong u.
Afy (Aphrodite)--ka khin baar u Hallijohn na ka tnga baar, hadien kata ka tnga u Jiffin.
Locksley-uba shang siat sim.
Otway Bethel--uba iaid riam sim.
Kapten Thorn-u sbipai ha ka jingsuba.
Colonel Bethel-u pasan u Otway Bethel.
Tom & Jack Herbert-ki khun u Justice Herbert.
Smith & Herbert-ki paralok u Justice Hare.
Rev & Mrs Little-ki phajri ka East bad West Lynne.
Mrs & Misses Ducie--ki theidonburom ka West Lynne.
Wainwright & Martin--ki doktor.
Mr Jones--u rangbah tep briew.
Mr Kane--u nongtem jingtem ha East Lynne.
Carews--kiba mut wai ing ha East Lynne.
Ball & Rubiny--ki riewsaid mukotduma ha ka kam pyn- iap-briew.
